source.title: Assessing technologies for expanding renewable energy in Kerala

source_context.rooftop_statement: More studies are required to determine the rooftop solar potential.
source_context.floating_statement: Published contextual literature range, not a site-eligible capacity assessment.
limitations: Working-paper synthesis based on literature and stakeholder consultations.
Potential values are not Kerala statutory land, forest, wetland, ESZ, setback or grid-hosting approvals.
The utility-scale solar value is broader than the CSTEP 2024 2,423 MW usable-ground-solar scenario.
No numeric rooftop technical ceiling is supplied.
